responses.draft_cover_letter:
Having designed and built REST APIs in Python with FastAPI and SQLAlchemy, I delivered services that processed three million requests daily. The APIs were containerized and documented with OpenAPI, facilitating easy integration by front‑end teams. This experience aligns directly with Little Oak Software’s need for solid Python development on web applications for charities.  

In the same role I owned the PostgreSQL data model, partitioned the invoices table and tuned queries, reducing the 95th‑percentile API latency from 900 ms to 180 ms. I also implemented automated migrations and wrote comprehensive unit tests to ensure data integrity during releases. The resulting performance gains demonstrate my ability to work with SQL at scale.  

I introduced pytest suites, contract tests and GitHub Actions pipelines, accelerating deployments from weekly to daily. While my work has involved Git‑based automation, I look forward to expanding my day‑to‑day version‑control practice within a collaborative team. Collaborating through pull‑requests, I reviewed teammates’ code and resolved merge conflicts, strengthening my practical Git experience.  

Outside of work I built a personal budgeting application using Next.js and Supabase, a project that required rapid learning of new frameworks and cloud services. I am excited about applying these skills to develop accessible, maintainable web tools that amplify the impact of charitable organisations.
